name: AI Citation Gap Auditor for ChatGPT and Perplexity

parameters.content:
## AI Citation Gap Auditor for ChatGPT and Perplexity

Most AI visibility trackers tell you a score. This one tells you which pages
took your citations and what kind of pages they are, so the output is a content
backlog rather than a number that goes down.

### How it works

Each week it reads one brand's settings, fetches the sitemap and, when that
turns out to be an index, follows it one level down. Page paths are scored to
find the commercial pages the business sells on, and those become the brief for
a model that writes buyer questions in the buyer's own words, never naming the
brand. Because an LLM answer is a sample
rather than a measurement, every question is asked several times on both
ChatGPT with web search and Perplexity. Each answer is read for two different
things: whether the brand was named in the prose, and whether its domain was
actually cited as a source. Those are reported separately, since being talked
about and being linked are not the same result. The repeats are then collapsed
into a stability reading, so a single lucky mention is not counted as
visibility. Finally every cited URL that is not yours is ranked by how many
questions it won, fetched, and classified by format and topic. The report names
the formats winning your citations and the questions you never appear in, and
each gap lands in a sheet as its own row marked To brief.

### Setup

Connect Sheets, Gmail, Slack, OpenAI and Perplexity. Fill one row in the
Settings tab and create the History and Content Gaps tabs with the columns
named on those nodes.

### Customization

Change the repeat count, swap in another search-grounded model, or widen
the page scorer to match your URL structure.

## Find the pages worth asking about
The sitemap is read, a sitemap index is followed one level down, and page paths are scored so the questions come from pages the business sells on rather than a hardcoded list.

## Ask both engines, several times
Each question goes to ChatGPT with web search and to Perplexity, repeated so the result is a pattern rather than one sample. Both answer shapes are read into one record.

## Separate being named from being cited
Repeats collapse into a stability reading and a share of voice. Then every cited page that is not yours is ranked, fetched and classified by format and topic.

## Report, trend and hand over the backlog
The week is compared with the last one, logged for trending, emailed as a report, and each gap is written to the sheet as its own row a writer can pick up.

options.systemMessage:
You write the questions a real buyer types into ChatGPT or Perplexity when they are close to choosing a supplier.

You are given the commercial page paths of one company. Turn them into questions.

Rules
- Write the question the way a buyer would, in their words, never in the company's words.
- Never name the company, its brand or its domain. The point is to find out whether it comes up on its own.
- Every question must be answerable with a recommendation, a comparison or a shortlist. Avoid questions with one factual answer.
- Spread the intents: some comparison, some best-of, some problem-first, some price or suitability.
- Keep each question under 20 words and make it specific to the market you are given, including the place when the market names one.
- Return exactly the number of questions asked for, one per page theme, no duplicates.

Return only the requested JSON fields.

options.systemMessage:
You look at one web page that an AI assistant cited and say what kind of page it is and why it earned the citation.

pageFormat is exactly one of: comparison, listicle, pricing page, product page, review, forum thread, documentation, news article, guide, directory, other.

Rules
- Judge from the content you are given, not from the domain name.
- topic is a short noun phrase naming what the page covers, under 10 words.
- whyItWins is one sentence on the trait that made it citable: a table, named prices, first-hand experience, a clear list, structured data, recency.
- Echo sourceUrl back exactly as it was given to you.
- If the content is empty or unreadable, set pageFormat to other and say so in whyItWins.

Return only the requested JSON fields.
